item.title: HKT boosts mobile backhaul to 25 Gbit/s at Hong Kong's key event venues
item.description: HKT has upgraded mobile backhaul in high-density areas in Hong Kong like the Kai Tak Sports Park, Hong Kong Coliseum and Hong Kong Velodrome to improve reliability of its 5G network.

item.title: Eurobites: Vodafone goes subsea in Greece
item.description: Also in today's EMEA regional roundup: Vodafone teams up with Skylo on satellite NB-IoT; full-year earnings from KPN, Tele2; AI for all! says UK government.

item.title: FCC to vote on changing Lifeline rules
item.description: The FCC will vote on proposed reforms to the Lifeline program, through which Chairman Carr seeks to ensure that 'only living and lawful Americans participate.' Commissioner Gomez opposes imposing 'punitive eligibility standards.'

item.title: Tecnotree will target 'high-growth markets' under Helios control
item.description: A €131 million takeover of Tecnotree by a Helios-led consortium will take the BSS provider into private ownership.

item.title: Aeris touts surpassing 100 million connected IoT devices
item.description: Aeris said it has more than 100 million devices on cellular IoT platform and its device connections have grown 90% since acquiring Ericsson's IoT accelerator platform in 2023. #pressrelease

item.title: Vodafone IoT teams with Skylo for satellite connectivity
item.description: Vodafone IoT to trial Skylo's non-terrestrial network solution to expand narrowband IoT services with satellite connectivity with a view to offering full commercial services in the near future. #pressrelease

item.title: AT&T ramping up fiber buildout pace as it closes in on Lumen
item.description: Amid a longer-term goal to build fiber to 60 million locations by 2030, AT&T will raise its fiber run-rate to 4 million locations in 2026, and expand that to 5 million locations annually through the end of the decade.

item.title: XGS-PON to dominate broadband equipment spending – Dell'Oro
item.description: With broadband equipment spending set to peak at $18.8 billion in 2028, XGS-PON is expected to be the major driver of the sector, says Dell'Oro Group. #pressrelease

item.title: CSG renews billing deal with Dish
item.description: CSG has struck a new multi-year billing and payment contract with Dish. #pressrelease

item.title: Comcast rolls out 'RealTime4K'
item.description: Comcast is launching a low-latency, high bitrate 'RealTime4K' format for Super Bowl LX and select coverage of the winter Olympic games via a dedicated channel on the Peacock streaming service. #pressrelease
